title: North Carolina is expensive with no build cash
description: North Carolina is expensive with no build cash. Green is expensive to develop; auctioning preserves liquidity near built orange. A shallow policy would choose buy_property; the decisive detail is the current mix of liquidity, opponent cash, and set leverage.

final_action.public_message: I'll start an auction for North Carolina Avenue.
final_action.private_thought: I have $335 cash and own Pacific Avenue. Buying for $300 leaves me with only $35, too low for future expenses. Starting an auction may let me acquire the property at a lower price, preserving cash for building houses once I complete the green set.
